tha-ap80:1.1: Pāṭalipupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantaṃ antarāpaṇe / kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap80:2.1: Seṭṭhiputto tadā āsiṃ sukhumālo sukheṭhito / ucchaṅge pāṭalīpupphaṃ katvā taṃ abhisaṃhariṃ. // //
tha-ap80:3.1: Haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena pupphena abhipūjayiṃ / Tissaṃ lokaviduṃ nāthaṃ naradevaṃ namass' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap80:4.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap80:5.1: Ito tesaṭṭhi kappamhi Abhisammata-nāmako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahābalo. // //
tha-ap80:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap80:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pāṭalipupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
